purpose: Teach: 国名/軽自動車/預ける/最大手/料率/概論/役務/全日空

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究論文の国名表記はISO規格に従え
lines.en: Ren, make sure the country names in your paper follow ISO standards.
lines.style: Direct, measured instruction. Calm authority without sharpness. Pauses slightly after his name—he's giving guidance, not criticism. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。フィールドワークに軽自動車を活用しました
lines.en: Yes. I used a light truck for the fieldwork portion.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive acknowledgment. Slight lift at the start to show he's listening. Then straightforward, matter-of-fact delivery of what he did. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究データを安全な保管庫に預ける方針だ
lines.en: Ren, you need to store your research data in a secure repository.
lines.style: Firm directive. No question mark in the voice—this is a requirement, not a suggestion. Clipped, businesslike. The tone of someone who has seen data lost before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で業界最大手の研究を学習しました
lines.en: Yes. I studied the leading company's research presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Quick confirmation. Eager to show he's already taken initiative. Slight energy lift—he's trying to demonstrate he's thoughtful about his work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費の料率計算を確認しろ
lines.style: Sharp, specific instruction. The tone shifts slightly—more pressure here. Direct eye contact. This is something that needs checking now, not later.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の冒頭に研究概論を入れました
lines.en: Yes. I've added a research overview to the paper's opening section.
lines.style: Prompt, focused reply. He's moving quickly through his checklist—showing he's on top of things. Slight relief in the delivery, like he's checking boxes correctly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室間の役務分担を明確にしろ
lines.en: Ren, clarify the division of responsibilities between the lab groups.
lines.style: Final instruction, weighted with importance. Slightly slower than the previous directive. The tone of someone establishing accountability. Deliberate and clear.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。全日空便で学会に向かう手配をしました
lines.en: Yes. I've arranged the ANA flights for the conference.
lines.style: Rapid-fire acknowledgment with quiet satisfaction. He's finished the list. The "yes" comes immediately, voice steady. A small sense of relief that preparations are complete.
